scenes.headline: MOSA: ONE *AI WORKFLOW*
scenes.sub: Stop moving prompts between five apps
scenes.say: Mosa puts your scattered AI tools onto one visual canvas, so a single workflow can make a whole campaign.
Connect text, image, video and voice nodes, instead of moving prompts and files between separate apps.

scenes.heading: BUILD IT, THEN *REUSE IT*
steps: Reuse for another product or format
scenes.say: You can branch the flow, add quality checks, and reuse it for another product or format.

scenes.heading: SEE THE *COST*
scenes.say: An agent helps build and debug the workflow, while cost tracking shows what each step spends.

scenes.heading: THE FREE *START*
scenes.label: starting credit · once, not every month
scenes.say: But free does not mean unlimited. New accounts get five euros in starting credit, once.

cons: Card or bank verification to start
scenes.say: You verify a card or bank account, and generations spend that balance. Basic is nineteen euros monthly, including nineteen euros of model budget, before tax.
So, metered AI in one workflow, not free access to every model. Would you use it? Comment flow.

youtube.title: Mosa: Your AI Tools in One Visual Workflow
youtube.description:
Mosa, from Ambassadors, connects AI models and creative production steps on a visual canvas: text, image, video and voice generation, conditions, quality checks and reusable workflows. The free workspace includes €5 once and requires card/bank verification. Model/provider calls spend the balance. Basic is €19/month excluding VAT, with €19 in model budget; plan features and costs vary. Not unlimited free generation. Official product media is shown, not a claim of independent paid-account testing.
Sources: https://getmosa.ai/ and https://getmosa.ai/pricing
